draft.title: Migration and cultural diversity
card: Cultural diversity means a place has people from many cultural backgrounds. They may differ in language, religion, food, customs and ancestry.
International migration has made Australia culturally diverse. People who move here bring their languages, foods, celebrations and beliefs with them.
Most migrants settle in the large capital cities, such as Sydney and Melbourne. These cities have many jobs, and often communities from the migrants' home countries.
So the capitals tend to show the most cultural diversity. Many smaller towns and rural areas have fewer migrants and less diversity.
draft.remember: International migration adds cultural diversity, and it is felt most in the big capitals.

a.q: Which change would most likely make an Australian city more culturally diverse?
opts: More migrants arriving from many different countries
More residents moving between suburbs of the same city
More people in the city being born in the same suburb
More residents taking holidays to other countries
a.why: Migrants from many countries bring different languages, foods and customs, which adds diversity. Moving between suburbs is movement within the city, so it does not bring in new cultural backgrounds.
a.clue: Diversity needs new cultural backgrounds to arrive.

b.q: Two Australian places each have 10 000 people. One is a suburb of Melbourne. The other is a small inland farming town. Which is likely to have more cultural diversity, and why?
opts: The Melbourne suburb, as most migrants settle in capitals
The farming town, as migrants mostly settle in rural areas
The Melbourne suburb, as capitals have no internal migration
The farming town, as fewer people means more cultures
b.why: Most migrants settle in the large capitals, where jobs and communities from their home countries are found, so a Melbourne suburb is likely to be more diverse. The farming town is less likely to be, because fewer migrants settle in rural areas.
b.clue: Think about where most migrants choose to settle.

a.best: More migrants arriving from many different countries

b.best: The Melbourne suburb, as most migrants settle in capitals

check.summary: No problems found. The card's facts about migrant settlement in Australia's capitals are accurate and hedged. Both questions have one clearly right answer that matches the card and the explanations.
